findings.motion: Motion 9 To Concur HCS and H Amends (RCS S-439), Senate vote 27 to 18; Jarvis is listed among the ayes
findings.note: Senate vote to accept the House changes to S747, Elections Law Changes. The ratified bill text includes language on photo identification under G.S. 163-166.16 and on observers and election officials at polling places. Only the photo-ID provisions seen in the bill text are on the subject; the full bill covers more election topics.

findings.motion: Motion 11 Veto Override (RCS S-482), Senate vote 30 to 19; Jarvis is listed among the ayes
findings.note: Senate vote to override the Governor's veto of S747, Elections Law Changes. The override passed the Senate and then the House the same day.
